content_sections.heading: District Legal Services Authority, Sangrur Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit, the application fee, the honorarium amount or the selection process.

rows.information: Offline, at the Authority's office in Sangrur

content_sections.heading: About District Legal Services Authority, Sangrur
content_sections.text: The District Legal Services Authority, Sangrur works from Samjhauta Sadan, Sangrur, and its phone number is 01672-230725. It is engaging these volunteers under the Revised Para Legal Volunteer Scheme of the National Legal Services Authority, New Delhi. The notice carries the line "If You have the zeal in you, we need you".

content_sections.heading: District Legal Services Authority, Sangrur Para Legal Volunteer Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Selected volunteers will not receive any salary, remuneration or wages. They are paid only the honorarium due for working days, as per rules.

rows.pay: Honorarium fixed from time to time by the Authority

content_sections.heading: District Legal Services Authority, Sangrur Para Legal Volunteer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must be residents of the urban or rural areas of Sangrur district, literate, and have a spirit of social service. The minimum education is 10th pass or higher, and applicants must belong to one of these categories: Teachers (including retired teachers) Retired Government servants and senior citizens M.S.W. students and teachers Anganwadi Workers Doctors/Physicians Students and Law Students (till they enroll as lawyers) Members of non-political, service-oriented NGOs and Clubs Members of Women Neighborhood Groups, Maithri Sanghams and other Self Help Groups, including those of marginalized/vulnerable groups Educated prisoners with good behavior, serving long term sentences in prisons Any other literate person, preferably matriculate, who is interested in social service Two further conditions apply: No civil or criminal case should be pending against the applicant in any court, and the applicant should never have been sentenced by any court in any case. The applicant should not be an active political enthusiast of any political party. The official notification gives the full eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Place of work: the District Legal Services Authority, Sangrur, or the Sub-Divisional Legal Services Committees at Dhuri, Sunam and Moonak. Nature of work: voluntary, with work on different activities assigned from time to time as needed.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Legal Services Authority, Sangrur Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the prescribed proforma attached to the notice. It asks for your name, father's or husband's name, date of birth, category, permanent and correspondence addresses, education, field of work, any experience, and email ID. A mobile number is mandatory. State whether you want to work at the district or the sub-division level. Paste a self-attested photograph in the space given on the form. Sign the form and the self-declaration on court cases and political activity, adding the date and place. Attach self-attested copies of the necessary documents. Submit the application at the Office of District Legal Services Authority, Samjhauta Sadan, Sangrur, before the deadline. Self-attested copies to attach: Category document (SC/ST/BC/Minority) Permanent address document Educational qualification documents Experience document, if any All other terms and instructions in Public Notice No. 3958 continue to apply.

faq.question: Q1. Has the Para Legal Volunteer deadline been extended more than once?
faq.answer: Yes. It moved from 5 October 2026 to 19 October 2026 under Notice No. 4500, and then to 10 November 2026 under Notice No. 4911.

faq.question: Q2. Is a Para Legal Volunteer paid a salary?
faq.answer: No. Only an honorarium is paid, and only for working days.

faq.question: Q3. Can law students apply?
faq.answer: Yes, students and law students can apply until they enroll as lawyers.

faq.question: Q4. Can retired people apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Retired teachers, retired Government servants and senior citizens are all listed categories.

faq.question: Q5. Can I apply if a court case is pending against me?
faq.answer: No. The notice requires that no civil or criminal case is pending against the applicant in any court, and the proforma includes a declaration on this.

faq.question: Q6. Can a member of a political party apply?
faq.answer: The notice bars active political enthusiasts of any political party. Applicants must declare on the proforma that they are not one.

faq.question: Q7. Can I choose where I want to work?
faq.answer: Item 10 of the proforma asks where you wish to work, at the district or sub-division level. Work may still be assigned as needed by the Authority or by the committees at Dhuri, Sunam and Moonak.

faq.question: Q8. Which details on the application form are mandatory?
faq.answer: The proforma marks the mobile number as mandatory, and it is item 11 on the form.
